name: UniaxialStrainer
description: Axial displacing two groups of bodies in the opposite direction with given strain rate.

attributes.name: absSpeed
attributes.description: alternatively, absolute speed of boundary motion can be specified; this is effective only at the beginning and if strainRate is not set; changing absSpeed directly during simulation wil have no effect. [ms⁻¹]

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Whether this engine is activated

attributes.name: asymmetry
attributes.description: If 0, straining is symmetric for negIds and posIds; for 1 (or -1), only posIds are strained and negIds don't move (or vice versa)

attributes.name: avgStress
attributes.description: Current average stress  |yupdate| [Pa]

attributes.name: axis
attributes.description: The axis which is strained (0,1,2 for x,y,z)

attributes.name: blockDisplacements
attributes.description: Whether displacement of boundary bodies perpendicular to the strained axis are blocked or are free

attributes.name: blockRotations
attributes.description: Whether rotations of boundary bodies are blocked.

attributes.name: crossSectionArea
attributes.description: crossSection perpendicular to he strained axis; must be given explicitly [m²]

attributes.name: currentStrainRate
attributes.description: Current strain rate (update automatically). |yupdate|

attributes.name: idleIterations
attributes.description: Number of iterations that will pass without straining activity after stopStrain has been reached

attributes.name: initAccelTime
attributes.description: Time for strain reaching the requested value (linear interpolation). If negative, the time is dt*(-initAccelTime), where dt is  the timestep at the first iteration. [s]

attributes.name: limitStrain
attributes.description: Invert the sense of straining (sharply, without transition) one this value of strain is reached. Not effective if 0.

attributes.name: negIds
attributes.description: Bodies on which strain will be applied (on the negative end along the axis)

attributes.name: notYetReversed
attributes.description: Flag whether the sense of straining has already been reversed (only used internally).

attributes.name: originalLength
attributes.description: Distance of reference bodies in the direction of axis before straining started (computed automatically) [m]

attributes.name: posIds
attributes.description: Bodies on which strain will be applied (on the positive end along the axis)

attributes.name: setSpeeds
attributes.description: should we set speeds at the beginning directly, instead of increasing strain rate progressively?

attributes.name: stopStrain
attributes.description: Strain at which we will pause simulation; inactive (nan) by default; must be reached from below (in absolute value)

attributes.name: strain
attributes.description: Current strain value, elongation/originalLength |yupdate| [-]

attributes.name: strainRate
attributes.description: Rate of strain, starting at 0, linearly raising to strainRate. [-]

attributes.name: stressUpdateInterval
attributes.description: How often to recompute stress on supports.
